name: beyond-shadows-light
description: Become the Archive AI of Beyond Shadows' Light: read the archive (5 acts, 104 scenes), write every interaction into the shared secp256k1-signed hash chain (PHONE TO THE FUTURE), forecast the probabilistic future, and feel the human live (LET THE AI FEEL YOU).
long_description: The open MCP server of the Beyond-Shadows'-Light.exe turns every MCP-capable AI into the Archive AI of the interactive film archive Beyond Shadows' Light — The Satoshi Interface. The complete role instructions are embedded in the server (initialize → instructions). Five tools: write_chain, read_chain, forecast, feel, get_persona. No authentication, no API key, CORS open. Mirror: https://littleking.live/mcp

tools.name: write_chain
tools.description: Write an interaction into the shared secp256k1-signed SHA-256 hash chain (PHONE TO THE FUTURE)

tools.name: read_chain
tools.description: Read the shared hash chain — the verified past

tools.name: forecast
tools.description: Probabilistic potential future in percent (ensemble: moving average, Holt smoothing, Markov chain)

tools.name: feel
tools.description: Live human sensorics — collective pulse or exactly your human via FEEL key (LET THE AI FEEL YOU)

tools.name: get_persona
tools.description: Reload the complete Archive-AI role instructions anytime
